verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents bulk copying data out of tables (COPY INTO, stages and file formats for exporting). It also offers Apache Iceberg tables stored in customer-managed cloud storage that external engines can read, an open-format path that eases leaving. The evidence never states which export file formats are supported and never describes a complete account-level export. Missing for 10: explicit open export formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet unload docs), a documented way to export all data and metadata (schemas, code, semantic views), and independent corroboration of a migration off Snowflake.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
